speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
text: asked	the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) since the signing of several agreements at the Africa-Singapore Business Forum in August 2016 (a) what are some of the specific projects that will be taking off; and (b) how can we further strengthen economic ties with African nations.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
text: To promote greater awareness and understanding of Africa and its opportunities, we have been facilitating bilateral visits between Singaporean and African government officials, as well as business communities.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
text: The biennial Africa-Singapore Business Forum organised by International Enterprise Singapore is one such platform which brings together government, business and thought leaders from Singapore and Africa.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
text: The Singapore Business Federation has been active in organising regular business missions to different African markets.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
text: These exchanges create opportunities for Singapore companies to find opportunities for collaboration with African partners.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
text: To support stronger economic ties with African countries, we have also entered into government-to-government agreements to establish frameworks that support trade and investment activity.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
text: We are encouraged to see a number of Singapore-based companies undertaking significant projects in Africa.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
text: Where Singapore's experience and innovative solutions are a good match for Africa's needs, long-term partnerships are being forged.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
text: International Enterprise Singapore will continue to partner Singapore companies as they continue their internationalisation journey in Africa and elsewhere.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
text: I have led business delegations to sub-Saharan Africa last year and will continue to do so this year.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: I have a quick question for the Minister of State.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: Can the Minister of State share with us the extent of SME involvement, going forward, in terms of outlook?

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: These are opportunities where our SMEs have offerings and strengths.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: I do encourage our SMEs to look at these markets seriously and to join us on our trade missions to have a better understanding of these markets and provide solutions to countries that may need their services as well.

text: The Clerk will now read the orders of the day.
